statement: No leg of the cook's triangle (refrigerator, range, and the sink the cook preps at) is longer than 9 ft
rationale: NKBA Kitchen Planning Guidelines, distance between work centres: no leg over 9 ft. Past that a cook carries food across the room for every step. With an island sink the cook preps there; the window sink is then the clean-up sink, and its distance from the refrigerator is reported, not judged

mechanism.how: Straight lines between the centre fronts of the refrigerator, the range and the prep sink, from the cabinet positions in the model
